facts.fact: The Pôle Digital de l'Agriculture, de la Forêt et Observatoire de la Sécheresse says it now operates a drought-monitoring geoportal using satellite sources (CHIRPS, MODIS, SMAP), crop maps from Sentinel-2 imagery and a farmer agrometeorological e-service with NDVI, SPI and SPEI maps, developed under a FAO-funded LOA that closed 30 May 2026.
facts.system: Pôle Digital géoservices (géoportail sécheresse, e-service agrométéorologique)

systems.owner: Pôle Digital de l'Agriculture, de la Forêt et Observatoire de la Sécheresse

note: No schedule of publication and no count of farmers reached is stated.
